metaTitle: Keep One Problem from Becoming a Shutdown | SecuEdge
metaDescription: Split your network into separate zones so an infection in one place cannot spread everywhere.

hero.headline: Keep one problem from becoming a shutdown.
hero.sub: Split your network into separate zones so an infection in one place cannot spread everywhere.

challenges.title: Flat networks fail together
challenges.desc: Many networks are flat: every device can reach every other. When one machine is infected, the whole organisation is exposed. A leading Indian hospital lost critical services for days in exactly this way.

challenges.title: One infection, total shutdown
challenges.desc: On a flat network a single infected machine exposes everything.

challenges.title: Guests on the main network
challenges.desc: Visitors and contractors on the main network widen the blast radius.

approach.title: VLANs for every zone
approach.desc: Separate networks for admin, guests, labs, medical devices, billing or production.

approach.title: Zone-to-zone rules
approach.desc: Rules that decide which zones can talk to each other.

approach.title: Guest Wi-Fi separation
approach.desc: Guest and student Wi-Fi kept away from internal systems.

indiaContext: Separating sensitive zones supports the expectations of RBI, SEBI and the DPDP Act 2023.

process.title: Identify

faqs.a: Yes. Every feature is on every model.
